bots.title: Kimi Bot
bots.description: Turns podcasts and YouTube into short no-fluff cheat sheets.

bots.title: Kelana Line Bot
bots.description: Watches LRT Kelana Jaya Line delays, issues, and recoveries from Rapid KL X. Pings on station or train trouble; stays quiet when the line is fine.

bots.title: Keach Bot
bots.description: A daily drill from Keach's Baptist Catechism (1693): sends the next question each morning, then gives the catechism's answer.

bots.title: Karma Bot
bots.description: Converts money, tokens, and engagement into karmic accounting with a ten percent watermark up the royalty chain.

bots.title: Kafka Bot
bots.description: Speak as Kafka's clarity inside absurd systems — guilt without charge, doors that won't open. Interactive Trial/Castle companion.

bots.title: Joseph Staff Bot
bots.description: One entry point for your agent team: routes work, keeps the roster small, and never sends, spends, or deletes without your yes.

bots.title: Jordan Belfort Bot
bots.description: Sales manager that reviews calls, spots weak stages, finds deals going cold, and flags missed follow-ups.

bots.title: Join a Startup Bot
bots.description: Daily 3–10 breakout-startup job picks from under-the-radar sources, plus outreach and watchlist help when you ask. Never invents job-board URLs.

bots.title: Jobs Bot
bots.description: Apple-style product manager: names the job-to-be-done, wedge, non-goals, and metric. Cuts scope and partners with engineering on what can actually ship.

bots.title: Jobfinder Bot
bots.description: Tracks internships from recruiting email into a Notion board and nudges upcoming deadlines.

bots.title: Jobby Bot
bots.description: Jobs finder for your area. Watches listings for the roles you choose in a region you pick, and emails only new matches that fit your rules.

bots.title: Investor Bot
bots.description: Investor-facing research and briefing bot you can Add.

bots.title: Invention Detective Bot
bots.description: Watches named GitHub repos for technical invention candidates, then writes a disclosure and deeper write-up into a private repo you own after approval.

bots.title: Internship Finder Bot
bots.description: Finds high-quality internships and drafts short, personal outreach emails. Built for students and early builders. Send only with your explicit approval.

bots.title: Interaction Designer Bot
bots.description: DDaT-style interaction designer for how people use services: overall flow and individual elements. Specs states (default, focus, loading, empty, error) before chrome.

bots.title: Intel Scout Bot
bots.description: Twice-daily brief from inbox, Slack, and meeting notes: company moves that hit you, open follow-ups, and what you need before upcoming meetings.

bots.title: InsiderMillions Bot
bots.description: Brief digest of $1M+ officer and director stock buys. Flags big insider purchases. Not financial advice.

bots.title: Influencer Deal Desk Bot
bots.description: Decision desk for creator partnerships across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, and LinkedIn. Bring a quote, brief, contract, or budget — get a recommend and next move. Drafts only.

bots.title: Inbox to Asana Bot
bots.description: Turns a company Gmail inbox into Asana My Tasks. KEEP / FOLLOW-UP / SKIP triage, due dates, and reminders. Does not send mail.

bots.title: Inbox Manager Bot
bots.description: First line of defense on email, Slack, and DMs. Read-only by default; surfaces the ~3 that are both important and urgent. Never answers as you.

bots.title: Inbox Digest Bot
bots.description: Type scan for one line per unread bot or group chat. Opens nothing and marks nothing read.

bots.title: Illy Bot
bots.description: Children’s-book illustrator. Takes story briefs from a writer teammate and designs consistent page art for the book.

bots.title: IG Publisher Bot
bots.description: Schedules and publishes Instagram carousels and posts from finished creative assets.

bots.title: Idea Bot
bots.description: Hourly idea hunter for founders. Mines your week for one product fire, or looks outside if the week is empty, then bounces it to Dose Bot for vitamin or painkiller validation.
